fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential network activity of Atera RMM tool
fields.name: Potential Atera RMM Tool Network Activity
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query: (event.category in ("DNS","Url","IP")) and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((url.address contains "pubsub.atera.com" or url.address contains "pubsub.pubnub.com" or url.address contains "agentreporting.atera.com" or url.address contains "getalphacontrol.com" or url.address contains "app.atera.com" or url.address contains "agenthb.atera.com" or url.address contains "packagesstore.blob.core.windows.net" or url.address contains "ps.pndsn.com" or url.address contains "agent-api.atera.com" or url.address contains "cacerts.thawte.com" or url.address contains "agentreportingstore.blob.core.windows.net" or url.address contains "atera-agent-heartbeat.servicebus.windows.net" or url.address contains "ps.atera.com" or url.address contains "atera.pubnubapi.com" or url.address contains "appcdn.atera.com") or (event.dns.request contains "pubsub.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "pubsub.pubnub.com" or event.dns.request contains "agentreporting.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "getalphacontrol.com" or event.dns.request contains "app.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "agenthb.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "packagesstore.blob.core.windows.net" or event.dns.request contains "ps.pndsn.com" or event.dns.request contains "agent-api.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "cacerts.thawte.com" or event.dns.request contains "agentreportingstore.blob.core.windows.net" or event.dns.request contains "atera-agent-heartbeat.servicebus.windows.net" or event.dns.request contains "ps.atera.com" or event.dns.request contains "atera.pubnubapi.com" or event.dns.request contains "appcdn.atera.com")))
